# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, only the latest release of BFFX is supported.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| v0.x    | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within BFFX, please send an e-mail to **security@bffx.dev**. All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.

Please include:
- A clear description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce the issue.
- Potential impact if exploited.

We encourage responsible disclosure and will work with you to ensure a fix is released before the vulnerability is made public.
